name: network_baseline
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk network baseline. On AWS this provisions a VPC, subnets, and NAT gateways; on Azure it provisions a virtual network, subnets, and NAT gateways via the nested `azure` block. The target cloud is selected with `cloud`.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this network baseline.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the network baseline. On Azure this also seeds the virtual network name and the default resource group name.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Optional description.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: Provisioning mode: Create (the platform provisions a new network) or Import (adopt an existing network not provisioned by the platform — on AWS set vpc_id, on Azure set azure.import_vnet_id). Immutable after creation.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Cloud region (e.g. us-east-1 on AWS, eastus on Azure).

attributes.name: cloud
attributes.description: Cloud provider the network is provisioned in. Valid values: Aws, Azure, Gcp, K8S_ONLY. Immutable after creation. Defaults to Aws. When set to Azure, configure the nested `azure` block.

attributes.name: cidr
attributes.description: Primary network CIDR block (e.g. 10.0.0.0/16) — the VPC CIDR on AWS or the primary virtual network address space on Azure. Required when the platform provisions a new network; leave unset when importing an existing one — it is read from the imported network.

attributes.name: additional_cidrs
attributes.description: Additional network address spaces beyond `cidr` (e.g. secondary Azure virtual network address spaces). Consumed on Azure.

attributes.name: az_count
attributes.description: Number of availability zones (1-4). Required on AWS; ignored on Azure, which declares subnets explicitly via the `azure` block.

attributes.name: subnet_prefix
attributes.description: Subnet prefix length (e.g. 24). Required on AWS; ignored on Azure, which sets per-subnet address prefixes via the `azure` block.

attributes.name: nat_mode
attributes.description: NAT gateway mode: None, SingleAz, or MultiAz. AWS only; Azure NAT gateways are declared in azure.nat_gateways.

attributes.name: enable_dns
attributes.description: Enable DNS support in the VPC. AWS only; Azure custom DNS is configured via azure.dns_servers.

attributes.name: enable_flow_logs
attributes.description: Enable VPC flow logs. AWS only.

attributes.name: flow_logs_retention_days
attributes.description: Flow logs retention in days. AWS only. Required when enable_flow_logs is true; when unset the server assigns the value (computed, no static default).

attributes.name: env_tag
attributes.description: Environment tag applied to provisioned resources. AWS only; Azure virtual network tags are set via azure.tags.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scope IDs that link this network to a cloud provider account. On Azure this resolves the subscription and provider credentials.

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: Provisioner type: Cli, IacNativeTf, IacDuploTf, or DirectApiCall.

attributes.name: provisioner_version
attributes.description: Optional provisioner version.

attributes.name: azure
attributes.description: Azure-specific network configuration. Set only when cloud is Azure; ignored for other clouds.

attributes.name: resource_group_name
attributes.description: Resource group for the virtual network. When unset, the platform derives and creates one from the network name. Immutable once set.

attributes.name: dns_servers
attributes.description: Custom DNS servers for the virtual network. Leave empty to use Azure-provided DNS.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Tags applied to the virtual network. The platform adds its own managed `duplocloud-ai-*` tags server-side; those are filtered out of state so only your tags are managed by Terraform.

attributes.name: preferred_subnet_mask
attributes.description: Preferred subnet mask used to propose subnet CIDRs. Convenience only; per-subnet address_prefix is authoritative.

attributes.name: import_vnet_id
attributes.description: Existing virtual network resource ID to adopt when mode is Import.

attributes.name: subnets
attributes.description: Subnets to provision in the virtual network. When omitted on a new subnet, the platform seeds type-appropriate defaults.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Subnet name. Unique within the network.

attributes.name: subnet_type
attributes.description: Subnet type. Defaults to GeneralPurpose. Drives default delegations and security rules.

attributes.name: address_prefix
attributes.description: Subnet CIDR. Must fit within the network address space and not overlap other subnets.

attributes.name: default_outbound_access
attributes.description: Whether default outbound internet access is enabled. When unset, derived from subnet_type. false makes the subnet private.

attributes.name: attach_nat
attributes.description: Whether to attach a NAT gateway for outbound egress. When unset, derived from subnet_type.

attributes.name: nat_gateway_name
attributes.description: Name of a NAT gateway (from azure.nat_gateways) to attach. When attach_nat is true and this is empty, the platform assigns a default.

attributes.name: nsg_name
attributes.description: Network security group name. When unset, the platform assigns '<subnet name>-nsg'.

attributes.name: private_endpoint_network_policies
attributes.description: Private endpoint network policies for the subnet. Managed by the platform (always Enabled).

attributes.name: delegations
attributes.description: Service delegations for the subnet. When omitted on a new subnet, the platform seeds defaults based on subnet_type.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Delegation name.

attributes.name: service_name
attributes.description: Azure service name to delegate to (e.g. Microsoft.DBforPostgreSQL/flexibleServers).

attributes.name: security_rules
attributes.description: Network security group rules for the subnet. When omitted on a new subnet, the platform seeds type-preset rules.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Rule name.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Optional rule description.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Rule priority (100-4096). Lower numbers take precedence.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Traffic direction: Inbound or Outbound.

attributes.name: access
attributes.description: Whether traffic is allowed or denied.

attributes.name: protocol
attributes.description: Protocol: Tcp, Udp, Icmp, Esp, Ah, or * for any.

attributes.name: source_address_prefix
attributes.description: Source address prefix (CIDR, tag, or *). Use this or source_address_prefixes.

attributes.name: source_address_prefixes
attributes.description: List of source address prefixes. Use this or source_address_prefix.

attributes.name: source_port_range
attributes.description: Source port or range (e.g. '*', '443', '1000-2000').

attributes.name: destination_address_prefix
attributes.description: Destination address prefix (CIDR, tag, or *). Use this or destination_address_prefixes.

attributes.name: destination_address_prefixes
attributes.description: List of destination address prefixes. Use this or destination_address_prefix.

attributes.name: destination_port_ranges
attributes.description: Destination ports or ranges.

attributes.name: nat_gateways
attributes.description: NAT gateways to provision. Subnets attach to one by name via nat_gateway_name.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: NAT gateway name, referenced by subnet nat_gateway_name.

attributes.name: public_ip_count
attributes.description: Number of public IPs to allocate. Defaults to 1.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: NAT gateway SKU. Managed by the platform.

attributes.name: helpdesk_vpc_peering_enabled
attributes.description: AWS only. Whether to peer this network's VPC with the helpdesk platform's own VPC, so the platform can reach an EKS cluster that has a private API server endpoint. When on, provisioning creates the peering connection, routes the helpdesk CIDR back through it, and opens inbound 443 from the helpdesk security group. Prefer leaving this unset: the platform default is on, and the value it settles on is then read back as computed state. Setting it to true explicitly risks a diff that never settles — on an install where the helpdesk VPC was only auto-detected from the machine hosting the backend, rather than configured via the vpc-peering-config setting, the platform downgrades the setting to false, so a config of true differs from the stored value on every plan and re-applying does not converge. Set it explicitly only to turn peering off (false), which the platform always honours.

attributes.name: helpdesk_vpc_id
attributes.description: AWS only. ID of the helpdesk VPC this network peers with. Resolved and stamped by the platform; never accepted from the client.

attributes.name: helpdesk_account_id
attributes.description: AWS only. AWS account that owns the helpdesk VPC. Stamped by the platform.

attributes.name: helpdesk_region
attributes.description: AWS only. Region of the helpdesk VPC. Stamped by the platform; only meaningful when the peering crosses regions.

attributes.name: helpdesk_vpc_cidr_blocks
attributes.description: AWS only. CIDR blocks of the helpdesk VPC — the ranges routed back through the peering connection and allowed inbound on 443. Stamped by the platform.

attributes.name: helpdesk_vpc_peering
attributes.description: AWS only. Live state of the peering connection with the helpdesk VPC. Populated once provisioning creates the connection and the platform's peering worker accepts it; null when peering is off, unresolved, or the network is not on AWS. Written by two independent processes — provisioning owns the requester side, the worker owns acceptance and the helpdesk side — so fields appear at different times.

attributes.name: peering_connection_id
attributes.description: The pcx-* VPC peering connection ID.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: AWS peering connection state, verbatim (e.g. pending-acceptance, active, rejected, failed). Reaches active once the platform's worker has accepted the request.

attributes.name: state_message
attributes.description: AWS's explanation for the current state. Worth reading when state is not active.

attributes.name: requester_vpc_id
attributes.description: This network's own VPC — the requester side of the connection.

attributes.name: requester_cidr_blocks
attributes.description: This network's CIDR blocks, which the platform allows on the helpdesk side.

attributes.name: accepter_vpc_id
attributes.description: The helpdesk VPC — the accepter side of the connection.

attributes.name: accepter_cidr_blocks
attributes.description: CIDR blocks of the helpdesk VPC, as resolved when the connection was created.

attributes.name: helpdesk_route_stack_status
attributes.description: How far the platform got adding return routes on its own side: ACTIVE (all present), PARTIAL (at least one route collided with an unrelated existing route and was left alone), or SKIPPED (nothing resolved yet). PARTIAL is the one to investigate — traffic may work in only one direction.

attributes.name: last_error
attributes.description: Most recent error from the platform's peering worker, if it is stuck. Empty when healthy.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current provisioning status.

attributes.name: network_id
attributes.description: ID of this network baseline, for reference by dependent resources (e.g. a cluster baseline).

attributes.name: vpc_id
attributes.description: AWS only. ID of the VPC. Set this to import an existing VPC that was not provisioned by the platform (the baseline adopts the given VPC instead of creating one); leave unset to have the platform provision a new VPC. Computed to the provisioned or adopted VPC ID.

attributes.name: subnet_ids
attributes.description: AWS only. Provisioned subnet IDs.

attributes.name: nat_gateway_ids
attributes.description: AWS only. Provisioned NAT gateway IDs.

attributes.name: azure_vnet_id
attributes.description: Azure only. Resource ID of the provisioned or adopted virtual network.

attributes.name: azure_resource_group
attributes.description: Azure only. Resource group the virtual network was provisioned into.

attributes.name: azure_subscription_id
attributes.description: Azure only. Subscription the virtual network was provisioned into.

attributes.name: azure_subnet_ids
attributes.description: Azure only. Provisioned subnet resource IDs.

attributes.name: azure_nat_gateway_ids
attributes.description: Azure only. Provisioned NAT gateway resource IDs.
